## Scope check

Brew Terminal deliberately does not do the following, and requests for them will be closed:
trade execution, buy/sell/hold recommendations, price targets, allocation or timing advice,
portfolio accounting, telemetry, accounts, cloud sync, or legitimacy/sentiment scoring.
